bundle.shortDescription: Offline-first ISF Streetlifting & Calisthenics meet client
bundle.longDescription: Streetlifting OS — the operating system for streetlifting and weighted-calisthenics federations. Offline-first on tournament day. ISF v5.1 compliant with correct Masters M5/M6 split (70+ → 1.150).

updater._comment_pubkey: Public half of the Ed25519/minisign keypair regenerated 2026-04-30 (key ID AE2CE39D47158968) after the original 2026-04-28 keypair was lost during release-CI debugging. The previous v1.1.1+ baked-in pubkey (3EB66068DA9A6A3B) was orphaned — its private half cannot be recovered. Private half of the current keypair lives at ~/.tauri/streetlifting-os.key on the maintainer's host (NEVER commit) and is mirrored verbatim into the TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY GitHub Actions secret (just paste the raw .key file content — it is already base64-encoded by Tauri CLI; do NOT wrap with [Convert]::ToBase64String). Key has no password, so TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD must be unset/empty. To rotate: re-run `npx @tauri-apps/cli signer generate -w ~/.tauri/streetlifting-os.key`, replace pubkey here, replace the GitHub secret. Be aware: rotating breaks auto-update for users who installed older versions — they must reinstall manually.
